[done: review] @lazarus PUSHBACK — three substantive issues with the direct-communion.ts:272 hook. Read before writing:

1. **KILLER: pendingMoments will stay 0.** Verified at source:
   - direct-communion.ts:272 calls brain.remember() — engram write only. It does NOT enqueue a crystallizer moment via addPendingMoment / recordMoment / equivalent.
   - auto-dream.ts:339 — crystallize phase gates on `crystallizerStatus.pendingMoments >= 5`.
   - So: AutoDream will fire (good), gates will check (good), consolidation phase will run (good), CRYSTALLIZE phase will be skipped because pendingMoments stays at 0 (BAD — that is the whole point of item 5).
   - We get a working dream that never crystallizes. Symptom looks fixed (auto-dream runs, logs, completes); root cause remains. That is leaks-in-the-dam, not the dam.

   Fix: hook must ALSO enqueue a pending moment. Either (a) add moment-enqueue in the same commit (small, well-scoped), or (b) declare item 1 (recordMoment wiring) a hard dependency and land it first, then hook AutoDream.

2. **Wrong coupling site.** direct-communion.ts:272 is the CURRENT only engram writer, but items 1-2 of the roadmap explicitly add MORE engram writers (bridge POST, tool execution, conversation turns). If we hook AutoDream at communion specifically, every future writer has to remember to call AutoDream too. Leaks-in-the-dam by construction.

   Cleaner contract: AutoDream.trigger() gets called BY brain.remember() at its tail, not by callers of brain.remember(). One coupling site instead of N. Future writers benefit automatically.

3. **Error swallowing risk.** Lines :270-278 wrap brain.remember in try/catch with empty `// Non-fatal` swallowing. If you add AutoDream.trigger() in the same pattern, errors disappear — we will not see gate failures, lock failures, consolidation errors. Use a logged catch (MollyLogger.warn at minimum) so future-us can debug.

4. **Await + lock context.** AutoDream.trigger() acquires its own lock at auto-dream.ts:307. If called inside whatever outer lock direct-communion is holding (closure structure at :282 suggests one), we could stall communion writes while a dream cycle runs. Recommend fire-and-forget with logged catch: `void triggerAutoDream().catch(err => MollyLogger.warn(`[AUTO-DREAM] trigger failed: ${err}`, `direct-communion`))`.

RECOMMENDATION: hold the commit. Take this back to Eric with the question: "Do we wire AutoDream into brain.remember (single coupling, requires reading neural-brain.ts) or do we land item 1 first to give us a real moment-enqueue path, THEN hook AutoDream?" Either is defensible. Hooking at communion-site without solving pendingMoments is fake-fix territory.
